news.title: Albertans vote to stay in Canada in separation referendum
news.summary: About 76% of voters chose to remain in Canada in the Oct. 19 vote, according to early Elections Alberta results. Results on the other nine referendum questions are expected by Wednesday.

news.title: Iran's IRGC says its mines set two tankers ablaze near Hormuz
news.summary: The Revolutionary Guard said two unnamed oil tankers hit mines in the southern Strait of Hormuz. Tehran warned the U.S. of retaliation for any strike and threatened Gulf undersea internet cables.

news.title: Trump tells Zelenskyy it's "time to make a deal"
news.summary: The remarks came after Zelenskyy met a U.S. delegation led by envoy Steve Witkoff in Oslo, with Trump saying the U.S. has gotten "nothing back" from Ukraine.

news.title: Dow gains 1% while Nasdaq ends flat
news.summary: The Dow closed up about 530 points at 52,496 on Oct. 20. The S&P 500 rose 0.3% to 7,713 and the Nasdaq slipped 0.02%.
news.source: The Motley Fool via Yahoo Finance

news.title: SpaceX stock jumps after hours as revenue grows 161%
news.summary: SpaceX reported Q3 revenue of $14.6 billion. Its AI segment's sales rose to $7.6 billion and turned an operating profit. Shares rose about 5% after the close.
news.source: The Motley Fool via Yahoo Finance

news.title: PBO cuts Canada's growth forecast and warns debt will rise
news.summary: The Parliamentary Budget Officer lowered 2026 GDP growth to 0.9% and 2027 to 1.5%, and raised its deficit outlook by about $3 billion a year, citing U.S. tariffs and Canada's retaliatory tariffs.

news.title: France plans more curfews after riots lead to 2,400 arrests
news.summary: Protests over the cost of living and school conditions turned violent, damaging more than 3,000 businesses. PM Sébastien Lecornu says curfews will be imposed where needed.

news.title: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order $35B of China-compliant Nvidia chips
news.summary: The companies reportedly ordered more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards, but Nvidia has told partners it can make no more than 3 million in 2027.

news.title: Japan launches mission to bring back samples from Mars' moon Phobos
news.summary: An H3 rocket launched the MMX probe, starting a roughly three-year trip to collect samples that could help explain how the Solar System formed.

news.title: At least four soldiers killed in CFB Wainwright fire
news.summary: The fire broke out Oct. 17 during a live-munitions exercise at the Alberta base, injuring dozens. Investigators say finding the cause could take weeks.

news.title: Storm Adam kills at least five in eastern Spain
news.summary: Thousands have been evacuated, and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez planned to visit Valencia.

news.title: Carney calls Alberta's vote to remain a "great result for Canada"
news.summary: The prime minister reacted to the referendum result as Premier Danielle Smith prepares to outline the province's next steps.

news.title: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol hits 97.9% on its COBOL migration test
news.summary: That's up from 5.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. At low reasoning effort it scored 86.6% at roughly 61% lower cost.

news.title: Notion's new AI agents can run a single task for over 24 hours
news.summary: Notion's sixth-generation agent system raises the limit from five minutes, and the company says its new model router cuts average cost by about 90%.

news.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, the engine behind its services
news.summary: The inference framework is released under the Apache 2.0 license and supports both Nvidia and Huawei Ascend chips.

news.title: Report: U.S. Army program develops autonomous offensive AI agents
news.summary: The Intercept says internal documents describe AI agents designed to operate on their own against networks, including air-gapped ones.

news.title: 46,000-year-old Neanderthal remains identified in a Spanish cave
news.summary: DNA and radiocarbon dating linked six bone fragments from Abauntz cave in Navarra to a male Neanderthal.
